title: Add modem builders and validation
description:
Implement validated modem construction so users can create custom constellations and built-in presets with clear failure modes.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Builders validate bijection, bits-per-symbol consistency, and normalization requirements.
- [ ] Invalid configurations are rejected with explicit user-facing errors.
- [ ] Builder outputs are ready to feed both the reference and optimized modem paths.

## Notes

This task closes the core API story by turning the shared data model into a safe construction surface.
